name: The Girls on the Square
address: The Square, 1 Owen Grant St, Wilderness, 6560, South Africa
description_short: Relaxed all-day dining in Wilderness village square serving hearty breakfasts, generous lunches, and homemade comfort food.
description_long:
Nestled in the heart of Wilderness village on The Square, The Girls on the Square has become a local institution for wholesome, unpretentious meals throughout the day. The relaxed atmosphere and friendly service make it equally suited for solo coffee breaks, family lunches, or catching up with friends over a leisurely breakfast.

The menu spans hearty cooked breakfasts, generous sandwiches, fresh salads, and satisfying mains that lean toward home-style comfort food. Regulars rave about the consistency and portion sizes, while the coffee keeps locals coming back morning after morning. The outdoor seating lets you soak up the village atmosphere, especially pleasant during Wilderness's temperate days.

Its central location on Owen Grant Street makes it an easy stop whether you're exploring the village on foot or breaking up a coastal drive. With reasonable prices and a menu that caters to most tastes, it's the kind of neighbourhood spot that feels welcoming from your first visit.
